lastText: The Night EndsCornered at PurfleetNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15A PROFESSOR'S EXPERIMENT, AND ITS CONCLUSIONYou come back to Purfleet with the wolf at your heel and the fog behind you. You know what the old man's bread does, because you have felt it on your palm. It is a very short fight, and when it is over you are in the chapel at Carfax with a hand that will not close. The old man comes up the drive with the last of his wafers. He says it was a good experiment. He says that he is sorry it has to end so. The stories that last are not about a monster. They are about a very old man in a very large house, who stood at windows and watched people go by. The children in the village say that he used to leave bread on the sill. Nobody can say who it was for.
